title: Degradation fallback is never exercised: the only fixture produces a straight path, so the ratio/bend-cap trip is asserted vacuously
detail: The wire_setup fixture's tested bundle (rt@10,10 → host@18,16) crosses no other segment and clips no sprite, so the computed path is straight (n=2) and the `if p.n > 2` ratio assertion never runs. No fixture forces the WIRE_DETOUR_MAX_LEN_RATIO fallback, the WIRE_DETOUR_MAX_BENDS insert_bend-full fallback, the WIRE_STUB_TILES skip-cross branch, or edge/sprite detours. Hard requirement #4 (graceful degradation) has no boundary coverage.
recommended_fix: Add fixtures that force a crossing whose detour exceeds 1.5× straight (assert fallback to n==2), force the bend cap, and a stub-terminal crossing (assert skip_cross); assert edge/sprite detours land.

title: Flags-ON render variants have zero automated coverage; the wire-preview gate tool is exercised by no CI gate (preview-check is the unrelated R2a assist check)
evidence:
"Assist preview cross-check (R2a preview == sim routing)|tools/harness.sh preview-check"
--- harness/assist_check.odin:476: fmt.printf("assist preview-check: %d scenario(s) green (preview == sim routing)\n", scenarios)
detail: The routed/anchor draw branches in draw_bundles, draw_packets, draw_selection (view.odin), draw_crisis_outlines (crisis.odin) and draw_glow_edge (assist.odin) execute only when a human runs `harness wire-preview` by hand; T2 goldens all run flags-off. Nothing renders the variant paths in CI, so draw_path_band/draw_path_offset_band/fan stubs can break silently.
recommended_fix: Add a smoke gate that runs `harness wire-preview` into a temp dir and asserts exit 0 + non-empty PNGs, or hash-pin one routed frame; keep it cheap since the variants ship OFF.

title: The 6-test wire_path pin suite (odin test app/render) is run by no CI gate — only `odin test core` is gated
evidence:
"Core unit tests (the determinism + topology contracts)|odin test core"
--- .github/workflows/ci.yml:70:         run: odin test core
detail: Neither tools/ci-local.sh (10 gates) nor ci.yml executes `odin test app/render`; the cost-immunity/determinism/junction pins the PR's acceptance cites as green were verified manually only. The harness T1/replay gate (gate 4) independently pins cost immunity end-to-end, which is why this is a warning not a blocker — but the unit pins themselves can rot undetected.
recommended_fix: Add a gate `odin test app/render` to the GATES array in tools/ci-local.sh and the matching step in .github/workflows/ci.yml.

title: Pixel-level 'rendered twice → identical SHA-256' determinism is a manual claim, not a durable in-tree pin
evidence:
paths1 := wire_paths_compute(&v, &s.topology, &s.bundles)
	paths2 := wire_paths_compute(&v, &s.topology, &s.bundles)
	testing.expectf(t, len(paths1) == len(paths2), "path count differs between runs")
detail: The test file pins path-level determinism only (same map → same path points). The PR body's 'routed gate frame rendered twice produces identical SHA-256 hashes' exists nowhere in-tree (no hash code in harness/wire_preview.odin), so the routed variant's pixel determinism is undurable; the shipped flags-off render is covered by T2 goldens.
recommended_fix: Commit the render-twice check as a harness self-test (render one routed frame twice, compare SHA-256) or fold it into the wire-preview smoke gate.

title: test_ribbon_fan_apex drops the ok from node_slot(topo, 8) — node id 8 does not exist in the 6-node fixture; the apex assertion passes by coincidence
detail: wire_setup spawns node ids 0..5; node_slot(topo, 8) returns (0, false), the ok is discarded, and rs=0 happens to be the router slot — so apex_dist is measured from the right center only by accident. Any fixture reorder silently weakens the pin. Also violates the never-drop-an-error convention.
recommended_fix: Look up the router by its real id (0) with `rs, ok := pp.node_slot(&s.topology, s.bundles.bundle_lo[bi])` and expect ok, mirroring the test's earlier endpoint lookups.

title: The shipped flags-OFF state (route_wires/wire_anchors) is asserted by no test
evidence:
app.view.route_wires = false
	app.view.wire_anchors = false
--- harness/goldens.odin:57-58: 	rc.view.route_wires = false
	rc.view.wire_anchors = false
detail: Both flags are pinned OFF only by explicit init assignments; rg shows no reference to either flag in wire_path_test.odin. T2 goldens pin the harness render (which sets them false), but nothing guards the app binary's flag state — deleting the two app/main.odin lines changes the shipped look with zero test signal.
recommended_fix: Add a tiny pin asserting a freshly-initialized app/harness View has both flags false, or a lint grep gate on the two assignment lines.

title: Advisory test gate: CONCERNS
detail: P0 100% (cost-immunity dual-pinned by negative-controllable unit tests plus the T1/replay byte-identity gates). P1 ≈83%: determinism pinned at path level only (pixel claim manual), degradation fallback unexercised at the boundary, flags-OFF unasserted; anchor even-spread (n=4→90°) and ribbon fan apex fully pinned. Overall ≈82%: the flags-ON variant render paths and the wire-preview gate tool have no automated execution. P0 100% with P1 in the 80–89% band = CONCERNS.
recommended_fix: Wire `odin test app/render` into ci-local.sh + ci.yml, add boundary fixtures that trip the degradation fallbacks, and add a wire-preview smoke gate — that lifts P1 ≥90% and overall ≥90%, to PASS.
